names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 noiembrie, which prints «Caloni (Cali)» — the second form given as its alternative.
The form the troparion on the Palamite saints' page prints: «Kalonicea, cu buni copii».

feast.note: One of six named in the day's line for the Palamite saints. Their own page carries no Viață tab, only a troparion naming all six; what is written of her here is from the life of her son on the same day's calendar.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 14 noiembrie — «Sfinții Cuvioși Palamiți: părinții Sfântului Ierarh Grigorie Palama, Constanțiu și Caloni (Cali), frații săi, Teodosie și Macarie, și surorile lui, Epiharia și Teodota»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Μνήμη Οικογένειας Αγίου Γρηγορίου του Παλαμά»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους». No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. **The whole of the page's text is the canonisation and the day: «Το 2009 μ.Χ., ύστερα από πρόταση της Μητρόπολης Βέροιας, Ναούσης και Καμπανίας, το Οικουμενικό Πατριαρχείο αποφάσισε την αγιοκατάταξη και των μελών της οικογένειας του Αγίου Γρηγορίου του Παλαμά. Ημέρα μνήμης τους ορίστηκε η 18η Δεκεμβρίου.»** **The entry names no member of the family individually — it is the family as a company — and this corpus already keeps the six members as folders from the Romanian calendar, which names each of them on 14 noiembrie: the parents Constantius and Kalloni, the brothers Theodosius and Macarius, the sisters Epicharis and Theodota. The identification is the family named in both lines and nothing else, and a row is written on each of the six folders rather than a new company folder.** The page gives no year of birth or death for any of them, names no place but the metropolis of Veroia, Naousa and Kampania which proposed the canonisation, lists no relic and prints no hymn. **It names 18 Δεκεμβρίου where the corpus's six folders are kept on the Romanian 14 noiembrie, Gregory Palamas's own day; one attestation row per church is the schema, and these two days are two churches', so there is no conflict here — but the Greek calendar's keeping of the family apart from Gregory is worth an author's eye.**
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Kalonicea, cu buni copii, și Constanțiu cel cu cuget bun, mare nevoitorule, văzătorule de Dumnezeu, ierarhe, Epiharis, mireasa lui Hristos, Cuvioasa Teodota cea înțeleaptă, Teodosie și Macarie sfințite, vă cântăm nevoințele voastre. Slavă Celui ce v-a-ncununat, slavă Celui ce v-a strălucit lumina necreată și pururea fiitoare a îndumnezeirii.

source.text: Doxologia — «Troparul Sfinților Cuvioși Palamiți», the one hymn on the company's page, which names all six of them together with the hierarch their son and brother; the page prints no glas

english.text: Kalonikea, blessed in her children, and Constantius of the good mind; great ascetic, seer of God, hierarch; Epicharis, bride of Christ; wise and venerable Theodota; Theodosius and Macarius the consecrated — we sing of your labours. Glory to Him who crowned you, glory to Him who shone upon you the uncreated and everlasting light of deification.
